## Experience

- Hive Pro, Inc. — AI Engineer Intern (Jun 2026 – present, remote, Dubai). Production AI platforms (ISMS portal, customer onboarding and sales outreach agents); human-in-the-loop systems with approval workflows, RBAC, tenant isolation and policy guardrails; LLM/agent pipelines with Claude, LangGraph, RAG and embeddings, integrated with HubSpot, Slack, Gmail, Fathom and NATS; security and risk audits.
- Rainwire Solutions (WARDEC – Indian Army) — AI Engineer Intern (Jan – May 2026, New Delhi). Secure mobile app under NDA; fine-tuned an 8B LLM for 3-way classification (88–92% accuracy); Playwright/Selenium data pipeline; deepfake detection for video, images, text and URLs.
- Scrini AI — AI Engineer Intern (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026, remote). Semantic resume search over 10K+ profiles with sub-50 ms retrieval (FastAPI, Qdrant, HNSW); hybrid retrieval with cross-encoder reranking; Dockerised 3-tier deployment.
- IIT Delhi, FSM Lab — XR Intern (Jan – Apr 2025). Unity/C# industrial training toolkit that cut onboarding time by 75%; voice-to-CAD pipeline in Flask; 98% mechanical fidelity.
- Maker's Asylum — Technical Mentor (Apr 2025 – present). Mentored 250+ students in robotics and computer vision.
- A.T.O.M Robotics Lab — Technical Team Member (Oct 2024 – present). ROS2 GPS navigation for a Mars rover prototype; LiDAR + IMU sensor fusion.
